messages:
anya: heads-up: postdeploy streaming smoke failing in eu-central for convo-route after today's change window. probes time out during stream-init, lots of 524/timeout errors. @rob can you grab traces?

rob: which release and canary? i'll pull the trace and deploy events.

anya: release=convo-route-5.1.0, region=eu-central, canary=6% (rollout bot shows canary at 3180007700). repro minimal:```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://euc.convo.redwood/smoke/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE' -d '{"turns":["hi"]}' -N --max-time 8
``` -> stream open, then no payload and curl exits with 28/timeout. probes report "stream-init timeout".

deploy-bot: rollout event: convo-route-5.1.0 -> eu-central (canary=6%) at 3180007700. initial canary health reported green.

rob: looking at traces: edge accepted conn, routed to inference-streamer, streamer logs show repeated "prefill: awaiting kv-shard fetch" then delayed chunked fetches from CDN, then stream-init exceeds probe deadline. Backend returns 200 but payload delayed.

infra-bot: infra alert: increased CDN 5xxs for model-chunk endpoint in eu-central 30s post-deploy. might coincide with artifact churn during rollout.

anya: hmm this smells like new variant fetching extra shards on warmstart and our stream-init probe not tolerant enough. prefer to pause rollout and pin region to previous stable (4.9.8) while we debug. pin faster than rollback.

rob: agreed. plan: pause canary growth, route canary traffic back to convo-route-4.9.8 for eu-central, and temporarily increase smoke stream-init timeout from 8s -> 20s to reduce noisy alerts while we repro. Also add a short circuit to serve previous prefilled cached shards if CDN load is high.

ops-bot: incident INC-9202 created: "convo-route stream-init timeouts eu-central" assigned to rob, anya.

rob: issuing route pin now. routing eu-central -> convo-route-4.9.8 (canary traffic -> stable). ETA ~90s.

anya: adding release note snippet: "paused convo-route-5.1.0 eu-central canary due to stream-init timeouts during shard warmstart; pinned to 4.9.8 pending investigation."

infra-bot: CDN team notified. suggested quick mitigation: increase read concurrency for the chunk fetcher and backoff retries to avoid bursty failures.

rob: pin applied, smoke stream probes recovered to green. rolling back full release not necessary yet.

anya: please capture a repro with instrumented chunk fetch timeline: timestamps for shard requests, CDN latencies, and kvcache readiness. if we can reproduce locally, we can test hotpatch (backoff+prefetch) before resuming rollout.

rob: will run a staged repro with simulated CDN latency and post logs here. also will open a PR for a temporary probe timeout bump and a short hotpatch to prefetch primary shards during warmstart.

ops-bot: reminder: follow the pin/rollback runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins and update the deploy ticket with the pin + mitigation steps.

anya: leaving thread open for handoff. cc'ing product and support in case customers hit longer tails.

rob: will post repro artifacts and a short blurb for postmortem in ~40m. :thumbsup:
